summary.text: Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique is a dream path physique Old Man Yan Shi creates through research. Shadow Sect forms bodies of this kind from dream realms, and Fang Yuan later uses the same method.

claims.text: At Yi Tian Mountain, Ying Wu Xie recalls being born from a dream realm. Old Man Yan Shi sizes him up and names him Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique, calling that form the greatest accomplishment of his dream path research and intending him to replace Bo Qing as Shadow Sect’s greatest strength in suppressing the situation. Southern Border Gu Immortals read Ying Wu Xie’s aura as showing he does not have one of the ten extreme physiques, even while other extreme physique immortal zombies stand in the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation.

Old Man Yan Shi forms the body from a cocoon of light grown inside a dream realm, then names it on the spot: replicating Ren Zu’s methods, he calls it a completely new extreme physique and, having used rule path become real Immortal Gu to make it, names it Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique. He infuses it with a lump of soul, but the body does not wake at once.

The soul it later carries loses memories continuously: Old Man Yan Shi manages to remove the flaw that put the soul to sleep, but never the memory loss itself, which is why Ying Wu Xie keeps forgetting.

During the battle at Yi Tian Mountain, Fang Yuan uses change soul Immortal Gu to swap souls with Ying Wu Xie, and his soul covertly enters Ying Wu Xie’s Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique body, while Ying Wu Xie’s soul goes into Fang Yuan’s immortal zombie body and remains trapped in the dream realm in Fang Yuan’s place.

Purple Mountain True Monarch forms Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique bodies from dream realm cocoons during the second Yi Tian Mountain battle. Fang Yuan recognizes the physique from Ying Wu Xie and captures close to ten of the new bodies. Those incomplete bodies do not rise in cultivation over time: some are rank six immortal bodies, some are mortals, and only a very small number have rank seven cultivation. When such a body is killed, it creates a huge dream realm on the spot.

After inheriting Shadow Sect, Fang Yuan brings Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique bodies while fleeing and uses them to resist strong enemies until the stock is spent. Detonated bodies leave dream realms behind; he later recovers two such bodies with Pure Dream Reality Seeker Transformation and stores them in his immortal aperture.

The bodies’ advantage besides entering and exiting dream realms freely is that a soul sheltering inside one is protected rather than lost: during an earlier battle in a dream realm, Hei Lou Lan, Bai Ning Bing, and others escaped into such bodies’ immortal apertures and entered dream realms to survive, emerging safely once the danger passed.

The original Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique comes from Shadow Sect wisdom path great expert Old Man Yan Shi. His killer move Pure Dream Reality Seeker Transformation can create the most extreme form: eighteen hours to live, rising one rank every two hours, and rank nine at the final moment. Purple Mountain True Monarch’s incomplete version makes flawed bodies weaker than that original. In Fang Yuan’s previous life, Heavenly Court obtains the move, Feng Jin Huang perfects the flawed original, and Heavenly Court gains the perfect Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique as the eleventh extreme physique. Fang Yuan later captures perfected bodies from Feng Jin Huang, learns their creation, and can make perfect bodies, though he still uses Purple Mountain True Monarch’s incomplete move for some transactions because those bodies self-detonate.
A perfect body can exist permanently; with low soul cultivation, Fang Yuan may control one by will alone as half a dream path clone.

In that previous life, Duke Long borrows Feng Jin Huang’s dream wings Immortal Gu and Fairy Zi Wei’s deduction to use Pure Dream Reality Seeker Transformation against a dream realm guarding Dragon Palace. The resulting body is perfect and flawless, and Duke Long credits Feng Jin Huang’s modification, built from her own shatter dream killer move, for the result; he calls it the eleventh extreme physique.
